text: Which sentence requires a COLLECTIVE (non-distributive) predication that first-order logic cannot capture with a simple universal quantifier?
choices: The books are heavy (each book is heavy)
Every critic is admired by someone
explanation: 'The students surrounded the building' is collective — true of the students together though no single student surrounded it, so it resists the ∀x(...) paraphrase. The others distribute down to individuals (each book heavy, each critic admired, each rock grey), all expressible with ordinary first-order universal quantification.
